text:
mira: FYI auditor Sam requested an evidence bundle linking an RBAC change to KMS access and a vuln triage for ISO/SOC2 controls.
dan: OK. Window? I can pull kube-audit, cloudtrail KMS, and vuln scanner JSON.
sam_auditor: Window: 2024-04-20T00:00:00Z -> 2024-04-24T23:59:59Z. Deliverables: single presigned tarball, manifest.csv (event_ts, principal, event_type, resource, evidence_path, sha256, control_refs), reproducible queries, and redaction_log.txt. PGP signature preferred.
jules: For KMS, do you want Decrypt and GenerateDataKey events? We log both; also include alias->key mapping.
mira: Yes to both. Also flag any Decrypts by service accounts that occur within 72h of an RBAC add.
dan: Splunk snippets I'll run: index=kube_audit earliest="04/20/2024:00:00:00" latest="04/24/2024:23:59:59" (verb=bind OR verb=update) | table _time, user, verb, objectRef_kind, objectRef_name, namespace
index=cloudtrail_kms earliest="04/20/2024:00:00:00" latest="04/24/2024:23:59:59" (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey) | table _time, userIdentity.principalId, eventName, requestParameters.ciphertextBlob

jules: Packaging plan: s3://redwood-audit/1823456789/ with: manifest.csv, sha256sums.txt, rbacsnap-<commit>.yaml, splunk-kube-slice.gz, cloudtrail-kms-slice.gz, key-aliases.json, vuln-scan.json, triage_notes.md, redaction_log.txt, chain_of_custody.txt. Then presign tarball 7d and PGP sign manifest.
evidence-bot: Evidence ticket created: <https://tracker.redwood/EVID-2024-400|EVID-2024-400> assigned to dan.
sam_auditor: Include retention proof (Splunk index TTL + S3 lifecycle rules) and annotate any manual redactions with `REDACTED`. Also include a short control crosswalk (manifest -> SOC2/ISO controls).
mira: I'll draft the control_crosswalk.md mapping each artifact to SOC2 CC6.x and ISO A.9.x entries.
dan: ETA: stage initial slices and manifest by EOD UTC tomorrow. I'll post presigned link in the ticket and ping here.
sam_auditor: Thanks — we'll validate integrity and completeness after receipt.
mira: Thanks team. Jules, please capture approver in chain_of_custody.
jules: Will do, starting exports now.
